blocks.task_summary: Find the least positive value of x for which cos(x/2 + pi/3) = 1/sqrt(2).
method_path: Determine the first-quadrant reference angle: pi/4 since cos(pi/4) = 1/sqrt(2)
Set up equation x/2 + pi/3 = pi/4 and observe that this gives x < 0
Reject the pi/4 solution because the least positive x is required
Use the next solution in the fourth quadrant: x/2 + pi/3 = 7pi/4 (= 2pi - pi/4)

evidence.basis: determines pi/4 (or 45 deg) as the first quadrant (reference) angle (A1); attempts to solve x/2 + pi/3 = pi/4 (M1); Note: Award M1 for attempting to solve x/2 + pi/3 = pi/4, 7pi/4,...; x/2 + pi/3 = pi/4 implies x < 0 and so pi/4 is rejected (R1); x/2 + pi/3 = 7pi/4 = 2pi - pi/4 (A1); x = 17pi/6 (must be in radians) (A1)
